description: This file defines an API endpoint for retrieving a catalog item by its ID in an e-commerce web application. It uses minimal APIs pattern with ASP.NET Core, providing route registration and request handling logic, and interacts with a repository to fetch catalog item data.

classes.name: CatalogItemGetByIdEndpoint
classes.description: Defines an endpoint to retrieve catalog items by ID, handles routing and request processing.

methods.name: AddRoute
methods.description: Registers the HTTP GET route for retrieving a catalog item by ID, mapping it to the handler method.

methods.name: HandleAsync
methods.description: Handles the logic to fetch a catalog item from the repository, constructs the response, and returns appropriate HTTP results.
